title: How to make my mv project to apk?

posts.author: SonCasual
posts.body:
So, it seems android studio has changed quite a bit, im having trouble using the new one to make my apk for my mv game. I believe this android studio version is called narwhal or something like that. The youtube video on it is outdated as following along is no longer the same at all. so is there a tutorial out there? or can someone make one? im lost lol
have been trying for 3 days now.
Thanks in advance
edit: i figured it out for my specific project. the webcapsule and other things just were not cutting it for mine. had to tweak a lot of stuff but its working and even got it to do a full screen display with no bars at all at the edges.

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
MV/MZ - Create an Android App with Android Studio
Web App Capsule  I made a template to create an Android app from files deployed for web browsers. You can create the app using only Android Studio.  Steps  Open WebAppCapsule in Android Studio. Copy your files deployed for web browsers (e.g., index.html) into the WebAppCapsule/app/www/ folder...

posts.author: SonCasual
posts.body: thank you but that seems to be for web build deployments to apk. is there not one for android/ios deployment?

posts.author: DevRPG2k
posts.body:
Both links provide tools for embedding local files directly into the APK, so the user doesn't need an internet connection.
I didn't understand about iOS; as far as I remember, the deployment of applications in development is quite different:
Deploying a game to Android/iOS
